title: Create project repository and D-drive workspace
body:
# Create project repository and D-drive workspace

## Goal
Create a clean project repository and local D-drive workspace for the book download, metadata, and indexing project.

## Tasks
- [x] Create `D:/ShamelaMetadataIndex`.
- [x] Add project README.
- [x] Add `.gitignore`.
- [x] Add `.env.example`.
- [ ] Create GitHub repository.
- [ ] Push initial files.

## Blocker
GitHub repository creation is blocked until GitHub CLI or an authenticated GitHub repository target is available.

title: Preserve existing app RAG data on D drive
body:
# Preserve existing app RAG data on D drive

## Goal
Copy the current app RAG assets to D drive so the project starts from the work already completed.

## Tasks
- [x] Copy `rag-data/sources`.
- [x] Copy `rag-data/metadata`.
- [x] Copy index manifests and logs where useful.
- [x] Record copied size and file count.

## Acceptance
Existing language, hadith, tafsir, Ibn Taymiyyah, and pilot metadata files are available under `D:/ShamelaMetadataIndex/data/existing-app-rag-data`.

## Result
- Copied files: 348
- Copied bytes: 68,235,416,559
- Copied size: approximately 63.55 GiB

title: Build canonical book catalogue
body:
# Build canonical book catalogue

## Goal
Create a single catalogue that can answer: which books exist, who wrote them, what field they belong to, which edition is used, and whether full text is available.

## Tasks
- [ ] Import Shamela book info.
- [ ] Add author full names and death dates.
- [ ] Add field/category taxonomy.
- [ ] Mark source priority and edition preference.
- [ ] Mark whether full text is available.
- [ ] Mark whether metadata/index is built.

## Acceptance
The app can answer how many books by a given author exist and what status each book has.

title: Define selected-book acquisition policy
body:
# Define selected-book acquisition policy

## Goal
Avoid downloading every possible book blindly. Use a selected-book policy.

## Tasks
- [ ] Prioritize language lexicons.
- [ ] Prioritize tafsir and hadith commentaries.
- [ ] Prioritize reliable aqidah/manhaj works.
- [ ] Prioritize fiqh/usul books with clear principles and rulings.
- [ ] Prioritize tarajim/tabaqat books with stories and narrator judgments.
- [ ] Avoid abridgements where comprehensive editions exist.

## Acceptance
Every downloaded book has a reason for inclusion.

title: Download selected full Shamela texts
body:
# Download selected full Shamela texts

## Goal
Download full page text for selected books from approved sources.

## Tasks
- [ ] Resolve `book_id`s.
- [ ] Download only selected books first.
- [ ] Store raw page text.
- [ ] Store source URL and dataset provenance.
- [ ] Produce download manifest.

## Acceptance
Each selected book has full Arabic page text and source provenance.

title: Normalize Arabic text and source identifiers
body:
# Normalize Arabic text and source identifiers

## Goal
Create stable normalized Arabic fields without losing original text.

## Tasks
- [ ] Preserve original Arabic text.
- [ ] Create normalized Arabic text for search.
- [ ] Remove OCR noise only in search fields.
- [ ] Normalize hamza/alif variants for search.
- [ ] Strip tatweel and punctuation variants in search fields.
- [ ] Keep exact original evidence for citation.

## Acceptance
Search uses normalized Arabic, source modal shows original Arabic.

title: Build page, paragraph, and logical chunk layers
body:
# Build page, paragraph, and logical chunk layers

## Goal
Support both precise footnotes and broad research retrieval.

## Tasks
- [ ] Keep page layer.
- [ ] Add paragraph layer.
- [ ] Add logical chunk layer.
- [ ] Allow multiple chunks per page.
- [ ] Avoid chunks that are too small or too large.
- [ ] Preserve overlap and page context.

## Acceptance
Footnotes retrieve focused evidence while research can retrieve broader discussions.

title: Extract baseline metadata deterministically
body:
# Extract baseline metadata deterministically

## Goal
Use local deterministic extraction before AI to reduce cost and improve consistency.

## Tasks
- [ ] Detect Qur'an references.
- [ ] Detect hadith references.
- [ ] Detect book/source references.
- [ ] Detect common claim markers.
- [ ] Detect definitions and classifications.
- [ ] Detect principles, exceptions, conditions, disagreement, and consensus.

## Acceptance
Every extracted item has exact Arabic evidence and citation.

title: Extract language lexicon metadata
body:
# Extract language lexicon metadata

## Goal
Build rich language metadata for roots, terms, definitions, derivations, proverbs, poetry, and usage.

## Tasks
- [ ] Extract root meanings.
- [ ] Extract non-root word meanings.
- [ ] Extract derivation explanations.
- [ ] Extract multiple meanings.
- [ ] Extract Qur'an/hadith evidence used for language.
- [ ] Extract poetry/proverb examples.
- [ ] Mark contemporary usage only where supported.

## Acceptance
Word analysis can cite exact lexicon evidence.

title: Extract Islamic claim metadata
body:
# Extract Islamic claim metadata

## Goal
Capture useful Islamic scholarly material for footnotes and research.

## Tasks
- [ ] Extract definitions.
- [ ] Extract rulings.
- [ ] Extract classifications.
- [ ] Extract warnings/admonitions.
- [ ] Extract virtues.
- [ ] Extract scholarly explanations.
- [ ] Extract corrections and criticisms.

## Acceptance
Footnote generation can retrieve directly related scholarly benefits.

title: Extract hadith and isnad metadata
body:
# Extract hadith and isnad metadata

## Goal
Support hadith footnotes with grading, sources, routes, narrator details, and commentary.

## Tasks
- [ ] Detect hadith text.
- [ ] Detect collector/source references.
- [ ] Detect grading statements.
- [ ] Detect narrator names.
- [ ] Detect jarh/ta'dil judgments.
- [ ] Record differences between specialists.
- [ ] Link explanations and derived rulings.

## Acceptance
Hadith footnotes can cite grading and explanation from exact sources.

title: Extract Qur'an and tafsir linkage metadata
body:
# Extract Qur'an and tafsir linkage metadata

## Goal
Connect ayat to tafsir, scholarly usage, rulings, admonitions, and language benefits.

## Tasks
- [ ] Detect ayah references.
- [ ] Link tafsir passages.
- [ ] Capture how scholars use the ayah as evidence.
- [ ] Extract language points tied to the ayah.
- [ ] Extract rulings and principles derived from the ayah.

## Acceptance
Selecting a translated verse retrieves the original Arabic ayah and relevant scholarly explanations.

title: Extract fiqh/usul ruling metadata
body:
# Extract fiqh/usul ruling metadata

## Goal
Capture rulings, principles, conditions, exceptions, edge cases, ijma, and ikhtilaf.

## Tasks
- [ ] Detect ruling statements.
- [ ] Detect hukm category where present.
- [ ] Detect usul principles.
- [ ] Detect conditions and exceptions.
- [ ] Detect consensus and disagreement.
- [ ] Record who holds which position.

## Acceptance
Fiqh footnotes can explain the ruling structure, not just quote a loose source.

title: Extract aqidah/manhaj metadata
body:
# Extract aqidah/manhaj metadata

## Goal
Capture creed, methodology, sects, warnings, loaded terms, and scholarly positions.

## Tasks
- [ ] Detect creedal definitions.
- [ ] Detect sect/group names.
- [ ] Detect praise/criticism of groups or individuals.
- [ ] Detect methodological principles.
- [ ] Record scholar/source priority.
- [ ] Preserve nuance and exact wording.

## Acceptance
Aqidah/manhaj footnotes retrieve relevant, source-based explanations.

title: Extract biography and tarajim metadata
body:
# Extract biography and tarajim metadata

## Goal
Support person footnotes and biographical stories.

## Tasks
- [ ] Detect person names and variants.
- [ ] Extract birth/death where present.
- [ ] Extract teachers/students.
- [ ] Extract reliability/narrator judgments.
- [ ] Extract stories and virtues.
- [ ] Extract criticisms and corrections.

## Acceptance
Selecting a scholar name can generate a concise or detailed sourced biography.

title: Extract stories, anecdotes, benefits, and admonitions
body:
# Extract stories, anecdotes, benefits, and admonitions

## Goal
Capture inspirational or explanatory reports that support rich footnotes.

## Tasks
- [ ] Detect story markers.
- [ ] Extract anecdotes from biography/history books.
- [ ] Extract benefits and wisdom statements.
- [ ] Extract admonitions and warnings.
- [ ] Link them to themes and people.

## Acceptance
“Explain further” can retrieve valuable scholarly benefits, not just definitions.

title: Validate evidence spans and citations
body:
# Validate evidence spans and citations

## Goal
Ensure every metadata claim is grounded in exact text.

## Tasks
- [ ] Validate exact Arabic evidence substring.
- [ ] Validate source id/book id.
- [ ] Validate page/volume fields.
- [ ] Validate claim type.
- [ ] Reject unsupported AI claims.
- [ ] Produce validation reports.

## Acceptance
No source appears in the app unless its exact evidence can be opened.

title: Build lexical and metadata search indexes
body:
# Build lexical and metadata search indexes

## Goal
Make retrieval fast and filterable.

## Tasks
- [ ] Build exact Arabic lexical index.
- [ ] Build normalized Arabic index.
- [ ] Build metadata filters.
- [ ] Build book/category filters.
- [ ] Build claim-type filters.
- [ ] Add relevance scoring.

## Acceptance
The app can retrieve relevant evidence quickly by term, phrase, source type, and footnote type.

title: Add semantic/vector retrieval layer
body:
# Add semantic/vector retrieval layer

## Goal
Support concept/passage search beyond exact terms.

## Tasks
- [ ] Choose embedding model.
- [ ] Create collection schema.
- [ ] Embed selected chunks.
- [ ] Store embedding provenance.
- [ ] Keep model consistent for future additions.
- [ ] Add hybrid lexical + vector ranking.

## Acceptance
Broad passage selections retrieve conceptually related scholarly material.

title: Add graph or hypergraph relationship layer
body:
# Add graph or hypergraph relationship layer

## Goal
Represent relationships between concepts, verses, hadiths, scholars, books, rulings, and claims.

## Tasks
- [ ] Define node types.
- [ ] Define edge types.
- [ ] Link claims to evidence.
- [ ] Link books to authors/categories.
- [ ] Link ayat/hadith to explanations.
- [ ] Link similar/expanded/corrective discussions.

## Acceptance
Research mode can expand from one source to related discussions across books.

title: Integrate indexes with word analysis
body:
# Integrate indexes with word analysis

## Goal
Use metadata and indexes to improve word analysis.

## Tasks
- [ ] Retrieve exact word/root evidence.
- [ ] Use multiple lexicons.
- [ ] Cite all used evidence.
- [ ] Open exact source text.
- [ ] Avoid irrelevant fallback sources.
- [ ] Mark AI-generated content where no RAG evidence is used.

## Acceptance
Word analysis is grounded, relevant, and source-checkable.

title: Integrate indexes with PDF footnotes
body:
# Integrate indexes with PDF footnotes

## Goal
Generate useful footnotes from selected words, names, ayat, hadith, or passages.

## Tasks
- [ ] Search original normalized Arabic, not English.
- [ ] Classify selection type.
- [ ] Retrieve by selected footnote type.
- [ ] Support up to 10 sources.
- [ ] Add “Explain Further”.
- [ ] Use source modal for every citation.

## Acceptance
PDF footnotes behave like a scholar annotating the book with grounded sources.

title: Improve source modal citations and source links
body:
# Improve source modal citations and source links

## Goal
Make source verification easy.

## Tasks
- [ ] Format author, death, book, volume, page, edition, editor, publisher, year.
- [ ] Treat non-numeric volume values as section labels.
- [ ] Open Shamela/source link when available.
- [ ] Highlight exact used source text by font color.
- [ ] Provide translation of source text.

## Acceptance
Every citation can be checked quickly and clearly.

title: Add footnote quality rules by type
body:
# Add footnote quality rules by type

## Goal
Each footnote type should have a consistent structure and relevance rules.

## Tasks
- [ ] Define Scholarly Definition format.
- [ ] Define Language Detail format.
- [ ] Define Qur'an/Tafsir format.
- [ ] Define Fiqh/Usul format.
- [ ] Define Aqidah/Manhaj format.
- [ ] Define Ikhtilaf/Ijma format.
- [ ] Define Hadith Commentary/Grading format.
- [ ] Define Biography format.
- [ ] Define Explain Further format.

## Acceptance
Footnotes look consistent and satisfy the user’s scholarly style.

title: Build evaluation set and quality checks
body:
# Build evaluation set and quality checks

## Goal
Measure whether retrieval and footnotes are improving.

## Tasks
- [ ] Create gold test selections.
- [ ] Include single words.
- [ ] Include names.
- [ ] Include ayat.
- [ ] Include hadith.
- [ ] Include full passages.
- [ ] Score relevance, source quality, and citation accuracy.

## Acceptance
Changes can be tested instead of judged only by impression.

title: Package local run commands and documentation
body:
# Package local run commands and documentation

## Goal
Make the pipeline repeatable.

## Tasks
- [ ] Document local setup.
- [ ] Document download commands.
- [ ] Document metadata commands.
- [ ] Document validation commands.
- [ ] Document indexing commands.
- [ ] Document app integration commands.

## Acceptance
The project can be resumed later without confusion.

title: Download and process all Ibn al-Jawzi books
body:
# Download and process all Ibn al-Jawzi books

## Goal
Download, preserve, enrich metadata, validate, and index this requested source scope.

## Scope
- Scope type: author_collection
- Author/source: Ibn al-Jawzi
- Notes: Select comprehensive Sunni/Salafi-compatible editions where available; include tafsir, hadith, biography, admonition, and refutation works.

## Tasks
- [ ] Resolve canonical Arabic names and title variants.
- [ ] Identify all available Shamela/HF catalogue records.
- [ ] Select the most comprehensive detailed editions and avoid abridgements unless no better text exists.
- [ ] Download full Arabic text to `data/raw`.
- [ ] Record provenance, edition, editor, publisher, and source URL.
- [ ] Record author madhab and scholarly profile where known.
- [ ] Normalize Arabic search fields while preserving original evidence text.
- [ ] Build page, paragraph, logical, and evidence chunks.
- [ ] Extract deterministic baseline metadata.
- [ ] Extract enriched candidate metadata where useful.
- [ ] Detect and label claim types, including definitions, rulings, principles, exceptions, consensus, disagreement, hadith grading, biography, anecdotes, language usage, tafsir usage, and source criticism.
- [ ] Validate exact evidence spans and citations.
- [ ] Build lexical, metadata, and source lookup indexes.
- [ ] Add semantic/vector index when useful.
- [ ] Add graph/hypergraph relationships where useful.
- [ ] Run quality checks and produce a report.

## Acceptance
This scope is available for grounded word analysis, PDF footnote generation, source modal lookup, and research retrieval.
